+ "ath.abs(den)>1e-9*len*elen){\n        var t=g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,ex,ey)/den,u=g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,dx,dy)/den;\n        var te=eps/len,ue=eps/elen;\n        if(t>-te&&t<1+te&&u>-ue&&u<1+ue){ts.push(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t)));}\n      }else{\n        var dist=Math.abs(g34Cross(c.x-a.x,c.y-a.y,dx,dy))/len;\n        if(dist<eps){\n          var rr=[c,d];\n          for(var k=0;k<2;k++){var tt=((rr[k].x-a.x)*dx+(rr[k].y-a.y)*dy)/len2;if(tt>0&&tt<1)ts.push(tt);}\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    ts.sort(function(x,y){return x-y;});\n    var prev=ts[0];\n    for(var s=1;s<ts.length;s++){\n      var t1=ts[s];\n      if((t1-prev)*len>eps){\n        out.push({a:{x:a.x+dx*prev,y:a.y+dy*prev},b:{x:a.x+dx*t1,y:a.y+dy*t1}});\n        prev=t1;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction g34Where(p,Q,eps){\n  var n=Q.length,inside=false;\n  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){\n    var a=Q[i],b=Q[(i+1)%n],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,len2="
+ "dx*dx+dy*dy;\n    if(len2>1e-12){\n      var t=((p.x-a.x)*dx+(p.y-a.y)*dy)/len2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));\n      var ex=a.x+dx*t-p.x,ey=a.y+dy*t-p.y;\n      if(ex*ex+ey*ey<eps*eps)return{s:\"on\",dx:dx,dy:dy};\n    }\n    if(((a.y>p.y)!==(b.y>p.y))&&(p.x<(b.x-a.x)*(p.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x))inside=!inside;\n  }\n  return{s:inside?\"in\":\"out\"};\n}\nfunction g34Clean(L,eps){\n  var P=L.slice(),ch=true;\n  while(ch&&P.length>=3){\n    ch=false;var R=[];\n    for(var i=0;i<P.length;i++){\n      var p=P[(i+P.length-1)%P.length],c=P[i],n=P[(i+1)%P.length];\n      var d1x=c.x-p.x,d1y=c.y-p.y,d2x=n.x-c.x,d2y=n.y-c.y;\n      var l1=Math.sqrt(d1x*d1x+d1y*d1y),l2=Math.sqrt(d2x*d2x+d2y*d2y);\n      if(l1<eps){ch=true;continue;}\n      if(l1>0&&l2>0&&Math.abs(g34Cross(d1x,d1y,d2x,d2y))/(l1*l2)<1e-6&&(d1x*d2x+d1y*d2y)>0){ch=true;continue;}\n      R.push(c);\n    }\n    P=R;\n  }\n  return P;\n}\n/* uniao de dois poligonos simple"
+ "s -> um unico contorno (com pontes se houver varios) */\nfunction g34Union(A,B){\n  if(g34Area(A)<0)A=A.slice().reverse();\n  if(g34Area(B)<0)B=B.slice().reverse();\n  var xs=A.concat(B).map(function(p){return p.x;}),ys=A.concat(B).map(function(p){return p.y;});\n  var size=Math.max(Math.max.apply(null,xs)-Math.min.apply(null,xs),Math.max.apply(null,ys)-Math.min.apply(null,ys),1);\n  var eps=Math.max(1e-4,size*1e-6*4);\n  var SA=g34Split(A,B,eps),SB=g34Split(B,A,eps),keep=[],i,s,w,m;\n  for(i=0;i<SA.length;i++){\n    s=SA[i];m={x:(s.a.x+s.b.x)/2,y:(s.a.y+s.b.y)/2};w=g34Where(m,B,eps);\n    if(w.s===\"out\")keep.push(s);\n    else if(w.s===\"on\"&&((s.b.x-s.a.x)*w.dx+(s.b.y-s.a.y)*w.dy)>0)keep.push(s);\n  }\n  for(i=0;i<SB.length;i++){\n    s=SB[i];m={x:(s.a.x+s.b.x)/2,y:(s.a.y+s.b.y)/2};w=g34Where(m,A,eps);\n    if(w.s===\"out\")keep.push(s);\n  }\n  /* vertices unicos (tolerancia) */\n  var pts=[],grid={},cell"
